title: Start or reuse the preview
responsibility: Starts one local preview or prints the address of the matching preview already running.

inputs.name: initializePreview.args
inputs.description: A string array of CLI arguments passed to previewArguments to determine the preview root, config file, port, and identity. Defaults to process.argv.slice(2) when omitted; each entry is a string, and parsing and validation are delegated to previewArguments.

outputs.name: initializePreview
outputs.description: Resolves with no value after it logs the preview URL, with a reuse-specific message when the matching preview is already running. The URL is emitted to stdout and is not returned.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: The function throws an Error when the preview ownership port is not an integer from 1024 through 65535. Option parsing, preview startup, and preview-owner failures reject the promise and propagate.
